## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or accepted decision when one exists.

## Verification

List the exact checks and results, omitted checks, and remaining limitations. State whether manual QA is required and include its result when applicable.

## Documentation and compatibility

Identify the documentation owner updated with this change, any changelog entry, and any adoption or migration steps. Explain when these do not apply.

## Scope and review

Note dependencies, required follow-up, and any authorization or publication stop that still applies. Keep the change within the agreed scope.
